acceptance.assertion: Every affected GitHub reader binds the requested repository, pull-request number, commit SHA, workflow-run ID and job ID to matching identity fields in the returned payload before accepting content.

Missing or contradictory target identity yields a stable fail-closed result before review settlement, CI classification, merge readiness or downstream mutation; the mismatch remains visible in diagnostics.
Pagination, redirects, cached connector responses and retries cannot silently substitute another PR, run or job; each page or followed response retains the original target binding.
Regression tests reproduce the observed PR #580 versus PR #546 target confusion and contradictory workflow-job log readbacks, and prove that cross-target data is rejected rather than normalized.
Focused read-surface, review-gate and workflow-readback tests plus full Grabowski repository validation pass on one exact reviewed PR head.

approval.note: The user explicitly ordered implementation with @grabowski. Scope is limited to target-identity validation, fail-closed readback handling, regression tests and documentation; connector-vendor changes, secret access, foreign-work override, merge and deployment remain separately gated.

goal: Harden Grabowski GitHub and workflow readbacks so every accepted payload is bound to the explicitly requested repository, pull request, commit, workflow run and job identity; mismatched, stale or cross-target data must fail closed before it can affect review, CI or merge decisions.

does_not_establish: truth of any mismatched historical payload
metadata.finding: During PR #580 optimization, one review-thread readback returned material associated with PR #546 and a generic workflow-job log readback contradicted the direct job-bound log. The transport-intent gate that blocked follow-up registration was subsequently fixed by merged PRs #595 and #604 and is live in runtime ae8c8a97209cb3d4e5a62bc47b8b57c23d85ee48.

rollback.strategy: Revert only the exact readback-identity hardening commit. Preserve mismatch diagnostics and test fixtures; do not restore acceptance of cross-target or identity-free payloads without a separately reviewed contract change.

title: Bind GitHub readbacks to requested identities
